observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a black Samsung smartphone held in hand. The camera module has four lenses arranged vertically with a flash and sensor. The brand 'SAMSUNG' is visible at the bottom. Two orange stickers are on the back: one says 'S23 Ultra S12', the other 'S23 Ultra S12'.
Photo 1 shows the same phone from a slightly different angle, with a glass display cabinet full of other phones (mostly iPhones) in the background. The same stickers and branding are visible.
The phone appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or dents. The stickers are handwritten and not official labels.
The watermark 'SEADOT GROUP POSTED ON JUJ' is present on both photos, suggesting a listing from a reseller or shop.

claims.claim: Mint USA used Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra
claims.evidence: The phone appears physically clean, but 'mint' condition cannot be confirmed without seeing the front, screen, buttons, ports, and internal functionality. 'USA' origin is unverifiable from photos alone.

risks.risk: Phone may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked screen, dead battery, water damage, software issues)
risks.proof: Front view showing screen, close-up of ports and buttons, and a video of the phone turning on and operating.

risks.risk: Phone may be stolen, blacklisted, or have a locked IMEI (common with imported USA devices)
risks.proof: Screenshot of IMEI check from a Nigerian carrier or official Samsung website, or a video showing the phone connecting to a Nigerian network.

risks.risk: Stickers may indicate a different model or mislabeling (e.g., S23 Ultra vs S23+)
risks.proof: Photo of the front screen showing the model name in settings or a close-up of the model number on the back or under the battery cover.

proof_requests: Front view of the phone showing the screen and bezels.
Video of the phone turning on, showing the home screen and basic functions.
Close-up of the charging port, volume buttons, and side buttons.
Screenshot of IMEI check or a video showing the phone connecting to a Nigerian network.
Photo of the model number from the settings menu or under the battery.
response.reason: The model is identifiable as a Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra from the branding and camera layout, but critical risks remain unproven: condition, functionality, and origin. Without proof of working state, screen integrity, and IMEI status, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be evaluated further.
